instructions:
TASK: You can't see your personal record in the challenge ABC

DESCRIPTION:
every other challenge's personal record does show, and in ABC when you do beat your personal record it says "new personal record" but you don't see it in the menu

REQUEST (from Amit):
@Big Sys implement and fix

Big Sys read the card, the code and the tracker first. Her hand-off: Fix Assets/_Content/Sandboxxer/Scripts/UI/Scorebar.cs lines 200-201. For ascending (time-based) challenges, `int scoreMax = MinExcludingZero(2 * scoreBronze, 3 * scoreGold); scoreMax = Mathf.Max(scoreMax, scorePersonalBest, scorePrevBest, scoreCurrent);` pins scoreMax to exactly the player's own best when that best exceeds `3 * excellenceScore`. ABC's Challenge has excellenceScore=40000ms, so scoreMax=120000ms (2:00); any personal best slower than that collapses to scoreMax, making SetTargetAscending's InverseLerp(maxScore, minScore, score) return 0 for a score that equals maxScore, which zeroes markerPersonalBest's rect width (line 385) and hides its child label (Scorebar.prefab: Marker - Details - Your Best > Flakh > Panel > Score Txt). Other ascending challenges have excellenceScore 135000-180000ms, giving enough headroom that real run times never hit this clamp. Fix: give headroom beyond the raw best instead of pinning to it, e.g. `scoreMax = Mathf.Max(scoreMax, Mathf.CeilToInt(1.2f * Mathf.Max(scorePersonalBest, scorePrevBest, scoreCurrent)));`. Do not raise ABC's excellenceScore — that moves the gold threshold instead of fixing the display. Verify by reading the challengesTracking entry for scenarioId 'challenges-abcs' in a save file (confirms a nonzero bestScore is already saved, isolating this to the display math), then in Play mode open ABC's Challenge details after beating it and confirm the personal record marker/label appears. Done = PR opened with this fix and verified in Play mode.
